classification_semantics.rule_local_exception_precedence: A matching exception embedded in a rule is evaluated before that rule's forbidden classification.
classification_semantics.baseline_preserved_edge: An edge present in the frozen pre-W21 baseline and not governed by a more specific target rule is canonical-for-W21-scope only. This does not authorize new sibling edges. The baseline pair set is closed-world for W21: a new source/destination pair is not baseline-preserved.

new_edge_policy.same_package: canonical unless a specific rule forbids it
new_edge_policy.consumer_to_approved_neutral_owner: canonical only for the allowed consumer families declared by that neutral owner

approved_neutral_owners.purpose: Shared operation/builtin metadata value contracts and pure metadata normalization used by skills, tools and planning.
allowed_dependency_families: agent.runtime.schema_validation (narrow existing pure schema-validation dependency only)
approved_neutral_owners.runtime_dependency_constraint: No other agent.runtime dependency is authorized by this owner declaration; if Lane A can move pure schema-shape validation into agent.operation without behavior change, that is preferred.

approved_neutral_owners.purpose: Shared, authority-neutral intent claim value contracts used by parsing and deterministic admission.

explicit_canonical_directions.constraint: Execution/implementation skills may consume canonical tool runtime contracts; shared metadata exceptions are governed by W21-R-META-005/006.
Planning may consume tool invocation/result contracts; planning metadata ownership must not live in tools.
Interaction may call deterministic planning/admission services; reverse planning-to-interaction dependencies are forbidden.
Only the explicit builtin adapter may depend from tools into skills.
Existing bounded construction surface only; not a generic reverse dependency authorization.

selector_schema.package_prefix: exact package/module prefix boundary; matches the prefix itself and dotted descendants
selector_schema.production_module_except: all production agent modules except the named exact module
selector_schema.exception_semantics: rule-local exceptions override the enclosing rule only for the exact exception selector

neutral_owner_invariants: Neutral owners contain data/value contracts or shared mechanics, not application objects.
No neutral owner may accept/store Orchestrator, AgentApplication, generic services: Any, or caller-domain registries.
No neutral owner may add model calls, authority decisions, approval decisions, or caller-specific execution policy.

residual_baseline_dependency_policy.principle: W21 converges the explicitly governed critical cycles and modernization seams. Untouched baseline dependencies outside those rules are preserved for behavior/scope control, but do not authorize new sibling cross-package edges.

known_examples_not_assigned_for_eliminat.reason: Removing ToolResult/runtime outcome coupling would materially broaden W21 beyond the frozen lane scope; no new runtime/tools edge is authorized.

known_examples_not_assigned_for_eliminat.pair: other members of the baseline package-level SCC
known_examples_not_assigned_for_eliminat.reason: W21 is modernization/convergence, not a repo-wide rewrite.

residual_baseline_dependency_policy.backlog_rule: Residual baseline cycles may be addressed by a later dedicated wave; W21 must not worsen them.

rules.reason: Tool runtime must not depend upward on planning metadata/schema ownership.

exceptions.reason: BuiltinToolAdapter is the explicit skill-to-tool adaptation boundary.

rules.reason: Canonical tool contracts cannot import skill-domain contracts; only the explicit builtin adapter may depend on skills.
Planning consumes neutral operation metadata/projections rather than skill implementation/catalog ownership.
Shared descriptor schema safety moves to neutral operation metadata ownership.
Builtin construction metadata must not be authored in terms of tool-runtime metadata contracts.
Metadata primitives shared by skills/tools/planning move to the neutral operation owner.
Shared process-tree mechanics move to agent.process; old tools path may remain only as an explicit compatibility facade with no canonical production consumers.
Shared bounded stream/reader mechanics move to agent.process; old tools path may remain only as a compatibility facade.
Untrusted intent claim value contracts move to neutral agent.intent; planning/runtime must not import interaction parsing ownership.
agent.operation is a neutral metadata/contract owner and cannot depend on consumer domains.
agent.process owns mechanism only and cannot import caller policy domains.
agent.intent owns shared intent value contracts only and cannot depend on parser/planner/runtime owners.
